summary.en: Houthi forces attempted an attack on the Saudi Aramco facility in Riyadh, prompting condemnation from Pakistan. The Baloch Army executed seven individuals it identified as Pakistani agents, while the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan killed police officers in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. In Hangu, a police constable was killed and three officers were abducted during an attack on a checkpost. The conflict still accounts for 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Houthi-styrkene forsøkte et angrep på Saudi Aramco-anlegget i Riyadh, noe som førte til fordømmelse fra Pakistan. Baloch-hæren henrettet syv personer den identifiserte som pakistanske agenter, mens Tehrik-i‑Taliban Pakistan drepte politifolk i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. I Hangu ble en politikonstabel drept og tre offiserer bortført under et angrep på en utkikkspost. Konflikten står fortsatt for 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
